title: Doesn't live up to claims
text: Doesn't live up to claims. I bought several sets for myself and family.  Everything was great at first.  But within 6 months, the pans started to scratch and everything stuck to the surface.  Called about the warantee.  Was told I did not handle or clean the pans properly.  In the trash and will start over.  What a waste of $$.

product_metadata.title: Copper Chef Cookware 9-Pc. Round Pan Set, Aluminum and Steel with Ceramic Non-Stick Coating Cookware Set, Includes Lids, Frying and Roasting Pans Accessories, Pots and Pans Set
features: COPPER CHEF 9-PIECE ROUND COPPER PAN SET COLLECTION INCLUDES: 5.8 Qt. Casserole Pan with 10" Glass Lid, 2.8 Qt. Sauce Pan with Glass Lid, 1 Qt. Sauce Pan, 10" Round Fry Pan, 8" Round Fry Pan, 9 x 3.5" Round Fry Basket, and 9" Round Steamer Tray Cooking Pans.

QUICK & EASY CLEANUP: We recommend that you clean your Copper Chef nonstick pan set by hand with water, a mild soap or cleanser, and a soft, nonmetallic scrubber, sponge, or bristle brush. Alternatively, you may put your copper cookware in the dishwasher.

ADVANCED CERAMI-TECH NON-STICK COATING: PTFE & PFOA FREE Copper Chef Cookware is the first of its kind designed with Advanced Cerami-Tech Nonstick Coating. We recommend that you use only nonmetallic utensils made of wood, plastic, silicone, or bamboo.

STAINLESS STEEL INDUCTION PLATE: Our Copper Cookware has an innovative, stainless steel induction plate built directly into our pot sets for cooking. It distributes high heat quickly and evenly to the entire cooking surface and is heat-proof up to 850°F.

WORKS ON ALL STOVETOPS: Featuring a Cerami-Tech non-stick outer coating and riveted handles for an extra-secure grip, this Copper Chef cookware is intended for kitchen use—but always remember to use potholders. Handles can get hot when on the stovetop.
description: This Copper Chef Cookware Round Pan Set is a must-have for at-home chefs of all cooking levels. The multi-purpose set features 9 Copper Chef pans to fulfill virtually all of your cookware needs. All copper pans come in our signature rustic red copper color and are an attractive complement to any kitchen. Plus, you get our premium mesh fry basket and steamer/roast accessories. Turn your non-stick pans into a stovetop deep fryer, make a delicious pork roast, or steam healthy fish! The award-winning Copper Chef is unique and versatile. From its functionality to its design, copper pots and pans are the perfect addition to your kitchen. With over 1 million Copper Chef pans sold, kitchens across the world are gleaming with Copper Chef. Most people want a pan that is not too heavy, free from harmful chemicals, nonstick for easy cleanup, and can stand up to the rigors of the hot stove. You may even find you don’t need to cook with the same high temperatures as with ordinary pans. Many reviews from Copper Chef customers say that their favorite homemade recipes are now faster, easier, and more delicious than they thought possible. And we hope you do, too!
